native_installation_limit: Live compute3 checkout still lacks shared release_controller.py and the opt-in executor/planner/runtime/CLI hooks. Compatibility is with reviewed proposed native source, not an already-enabled physical deployment. No live repository update or hardware action performed.

gripper_contact_proxy sums signed normal contacts from housing+two pads with exact contact-point moments in world/base axes plus own recorded bias; no clipping. Tangential/gravity/inertia/current-basedUR3 transfer is omitted and remains uncalibrated.
manifold_patch_v2 is a corrected contact-coverage approximation, not calibrated tactile pressure or guaranteed load retention.
Shared release controller reads only TCP/gripper/tactile/latch state; it does not read packet pose, bin-support scorer or task-success flags.
No controller compatibility claim removes the native asynchronous hardware/driver/servo-guard qualification requirements.
conclusion: No source-level obstruction to the declared combined bridge found. Actual two-seed physical placement + FINISH + no stop +60s coverage remains a required prospective gate; this audit makes no outcome claim.
